newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cliffs Drilling rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cliffs Drilling rated buy.

text.p: --Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Tuesday it initiated coverage of Cliffs Drilling Co with a buy rating.
--It set a 12-month price target for the company's stock in the $75 to $80 a share range. Cliffs Drilling was trading at 54, up one.
--Rodman said its EPS earnings estimates on the company are $2.03 for 1996, $4.20 for 1997 and $5.65 for 1998.
--Cliffs Drilling is involved in contract drilling, turnkey drilling and mobile offshore production.
